# The gleif pack

*GLEIF legal entities* · version 1.0.0 · code `GLEIF`

## What it is

Legal Entity Identifiers and who owns whom, from GLEIF: the ownership groups of the us-equities companies with an LEI and of the
large financial institutions (the FSB's G-SIBs, other large banks, insurers, asset managers and market infrastructures), each the
ultimate parent with the entities it consolidates, at most 50 a group, the nearest levels first. Every entity carries its addresses,
registration and renewal (late renewals flagged), its parents chain, its children and its BICs and ISIN count. Off by default; with
us-equities on, a company and its LEI record link both ways.

The documents are committed as standard test data, one snapshot per kind under `data/testdata/gleif/<kind>/`; `tools/drishti.py lake
demo` builds them into the demo lake and the pack's Delta connector `gleif-store` serves them, so the pack works with the demo
connector off. `samples/` keeps only a few reference documents.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `lei-entity`

**LEI legal entity** · mnemonic `LEI` · read through connector `gleif-store`.

**Id:** field `LEI`; pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`; for example `HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394`.

Fields, from 1 sample document:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | string | `HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394` | Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442, 20 characters) |
| `NAME` | string | `Apple Inc.` | Legal name |
| `OTHER_NAMES` | list of objects |  | Other and previous names, with their type |
| `LEGAL_FORM` | string | `For-Profit Corporation General Stock` | Legal form (the ELF code's name) |
| `JURISDICTION` | string | `US-CA` | Legal jurisdiction when it differs from the country |
| `LEI_COUNTRY` | string | `US` | Country of the legal address (ISO 3166 alpha-2), a link to its lei-country; link to `lei-country` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | `United States of America (the)` | The country's name |
| `LEGAL_ADDRESS` | string | `C/O C T Corporation System, 330 N. Brand…` | Legal address |
| `LEGAL_CITY` | string | `Glendale` | City of the legal address |
| `HQ_ADDRESS` | string | `One Apple Park Way, 95014 Cupertino, US-…` | Headquarters address, when it differs from the legal address |
| `REGISTERED_AS` | string | `806592` | Number at the business register |
| `ENTITY_STATUS` | string | `ACTIVE` | Entity status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE) |
| `CREATED` | date | `1977-01-03` | Date the entity was created |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | string | `ISSUED` | LEI registration status (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, ...) |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date | `2012-06-06` | First registration of the LEI |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date | `2026-03-03` | Last update of the record |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date | `2027-03-08` | Next renewal date |
| `RENEWAL_LATE` | boolean | `false` | True when the registration lapsed or its renewal date has passed |
| `MANAGING_LOU` | string | `Bloomberg Finance L.P.` | The LEI issuer (LOU) managing the record |
| `BICS` | string | `APLEUS66XXX` | Its BICs (GLEIF mapping file) |
| `BIC_COUNT` | integer | `1` | Number of BICs |
| `ISIN_COUNT` | integer | `956` | Number of ISINs mapped to it (GLEIF mapping file) |
| `LEI_GROUP` | string | `HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394` | The ownership group (its ultimate parent's LEI); link to `lei-group` |
| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS` | list of objects |  | Reporting exceptions (why no parent is reported) |
| `CHILDREN` | list of objects |  | Entities it directly consolidates, in the pack |
| `CHILD_COUNT` | integer | `8` | Number of children in the pack |
| `DIRECT_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | `8` | Number of direct children in GLEIF |
| `ULTIMATE_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | `20` | Number of entities naming it ultimate parent in GLEIF |
| `GLEIF_GROUP_SIZE` | integer | `21` | — |
| `MAPPING_IDS` | list of strings |  | Its identifier documents (lei-mapping); link to `lei-mapping` |
| `SEGMENT` | string | `US equities` | Why it is a seed (US equities, G-SIB, bank, insurer, asset manager, market infrastructure) |
| `US_COMPANY` | string | `AAPL` | The us-equities company's ticker, a link to it |
| `US_COMPANY_NAME` | string | `Apple Inc.` | The us-equities company's name |
| `PROVENANCE` | object |  | Nested: see below |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `OTHER_NAMES[]` | `NAME` (string), `TYPE` (string) |
| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS[]` | `LEVEL` (string), `REASON` (string), `MEANING` (string) |
| `CHILDREN[]` | `LEI` (string), `NAME` (string), `COUNTRY` (string), `KIDS` (integer) |
| `PROVENANCE` | `SOURCE` (string), `RETRIEVED_AT` (date), `LICENCE` (string), `URL` (string) |

Links: `LEI_COUNTRY` → `lei-country`, `LEI_GROUP` → `lei-group`, `MAPPING_IDS` → `lei-mapping`.

### `lei-relationship`

**LEI parent relationship** · mnemonic `LEIR` · read through connector `gleif-store`.

**Id:** field `RELATIONSHIP_ID`; pattern `^LEIREL-`; for example `LEIREL-010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03-DIRECT`.

Fields, from 2 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | string | `LEIREL-010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03-DIRECT` | LEIREL-<child LEI>-DIRECT or -ULTIMATE |
| `LEVEL` | string | `Direct` | Direct or Ultimate |
| `CHILD_ENTITY` | string | `010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03` | The child's LEI; link to `lei-entity` |
| `PARENT_ENTITY` | string | `549300COKYB5EGSU1838` | The parent's LEI; link to `lei-entity` |
| `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS` | string | `ACTIVE` | ACTIVE or INACTIVE |
| `START` | date | `2017-12-06` | Start of the relationship |
| `PERIODS` | list of objects |  | Accounting and document filing periods |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | string | `LAPSED` | The relationship record's registration status |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date | `2023-08-08` | First registered |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date | `2024-10-07` | Last updated |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date | `2024-10-07` | Next renewal |
| `LEI_GROUP` | string | `549300B2Q47IR0CR5B54` | link to `lei-group` |
| `ACCOUNTING_STANDARD` | string | `IFRS` | Accounting standard of the consolidation (in 50%) |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `PERIODS[]` | `TYPE` (string), `START` (date), `END` (date) |

Links: `CHILD_ENTITY` → `lei-entity`, `LEI_GROUP` → `lei-group`, `PARENT_ENTITY` → `lei-entity`.

**ISIN or BIC to LEI** · mnemonic `LEIM` · read through connector `gleif-store`.

**Id:** field `IDENTIFIER`; for example `WABTUS3WXXX`.

Fields, from 2 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## Data sources and licences

Everything GLEIF publishes is CC0 1.0: free of charge, no restriction; attribution is appreciated ("Source: GLEIF, LEI data").
The groups use the consolidation relationships only; fund management, sub-fund, feeder and branch relationships are left out.

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| GLEIF golden copy, level 2 (relationship records, reporting exceptions) | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | who consolidates whom (direct and ultimate parents), relationship periods and status, why a parent is not reported |
| GLEIF LEI API (lei-records, entity-legal-forms, countries, lei-issuers) | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | each entity's level 1 record, legal form names, country names, LOU names |
| GLEIF mapping files (BIC, ISIN, MIC, OpenCorporates to LEI) | CC0 1.0 (the BIC file with SWIFT, the ISIN file with ANNA) | no | the identifiers of the entities |
| GLEIF golden copy, level 1 bulk file | CC0 1.0 | no | full-country pulls into the data folder only (golden-lei source; never committed, for its size) |

Every kind's links to its data contract and its example and where its data comes from (an external source and the data feed that pulls it, a generator of synthetic data, or a Drishti engine) are below: *Data contracts* and *Data retrieval*.

External data: GLEIF golden copy, level 2 (relationship records, reporting exceptions); GLEIF LEI API (lei-records, entity-legal-forms, countries, lei-issuers); GLEIF mapping files (BIC, ISIN, MIC, OpenCorporates to LEI); GLEIF golden copy, level 1 bulk file. Each source's URL, licence and data feed are on the External data help page, [docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on no other pack.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gleif-store` | `delta` | `lei-entity`, `lei-relationship`, `lei-mapping` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `gleif-groupings` | `derived` | `lei-group`, `lei-country` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`.

## Refreshing the data

The data feed `gleif` (config/feeds/gleif.yaml) pulls `lei-entity`, `lei-relationship`, `lei-mapping`: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif` fetches them daily into `data/datafeeds/gleif/<date>/` and loads them into the lake `referencelake`; `--dry-run` says what it would fetch, changing nothing; `--snapshot` refreshes the committed snapshot in data/testdata instead; `feed status` shows the last runs. The External data feeds guide (docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md) has the schedule entries for Linux and Windows.

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/gleif/make.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.

## Data contracts

Every kind of the pack has a data contract: a YAML file beside the pack (`modules/reference-data/packs/gleif/contracts/<kind>.contract.yaml`, checked against `tools/contracts.schema.json`) that says what one record is, its key, how it is stored and dated, and every field with its type, presence, unit and meaning. The contracts are published on [docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md) and each kind's example (a real record of the test data, every field explained) on [docs/contracts/packs](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/README.md); this README links them and copies neither. Check them against the pack and its data with `python3 tools/contracts.py check` (or `drishti.py contract check`); show one with `python3 tools/contracts.py show <MNEMONIC>`.

| Command | Kind | Class | Key | Grain | Contract | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | `lei-entity` | fundamental | `LEI` | One row per lei legal entity, keyed by LEI. | [LEI: LEI legal entity](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#lei-lei-legal-entity-lei-entity) (`contracts/lei-entity.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#example-gleif-lei-entity) |
| `LEIG` | `lei-group` | computed | `GROUP_ID` | One record per GROUP_ID of the lei-entity records, computed when asked. | [LEIG: LEI ownership group](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leig-lei-ownership-group-lei-group) (`contracts/lei-group.contract.yaml`) | — (computed when asked) |
| `LEIR` | `lei-relationship` | fundamental | `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | One row per lei parent relationship, keyed by RELATIONSHIP_ID. | [LEIR: LEI parent relationship](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leir-lei-parent-relationship-lei-relationship) (`contracts/lei-relationship.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#example-gleif-lei-relationship) |
| `LEIC` | `lei-country` | computed | `COUNTRY` | One record per COUNTRY of the lei-entity records, computed when asked. | [LEIC: LEI country](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leic-lei-country-lei-country) (`contracts/lei-country.contract.yaml`) | — (computed when asked) |
| `LEIM` | `lei-mapping` | fundamental | `IDENTIFIER` | One row per isin or bic to lei, keyed by IDENTIFIER. | [LEIM: ISIN or BIC to LEI](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leim-isin-or-bic-to-lei-lei-mapping) (`contracts/lei-mapping.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#example-gleif-lei-mapping) |

*Class*: **fundamental** data is delivered by a source system and stored; **input** is stored data an engine reads; **computed** is worked out by Drishti when asked and never stored by a source; **drishti-owned** is kept by Drishti itself.

## Data retrieval

Where each kind's data comes from, how it reaches the lake and how to check it. Three origins: **external** data, fetched from a public source by its data feed (each source, its licence and worked examples on the [External data](../../../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md) help page); **synthetic** test data (or hand-written reference data), written by a generator with fictitious names; **computed** by a Drishti engine when it is asked, never stored by a source.

| Command | Kind | Origin | How it reaches Drishti |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | `lei-entity` | external: GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI (CC0 1.0) — refreshed by `drishti.py feed run gleif` | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-entity/` → `lake demo` → connector `gleif-store` |
| `LEIG` | `lei-group` | computed by Drishti: the derived connector gleif-groupings over the kind lei-entity; see the [Groupings and analytics guide](../../../../docs/guides/bi/README.md) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `LEIR` | `lei-relationship` | external: GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI (CC0 1.0) — refreshed by `drishti.py feed run gleif` | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-relationship/` → `lake demo` → connector `gleif-store` |
| `LEIC` | `lei-country` | computed by Drishti: the derived connector gleif-groupings over the kind lei-entity; see the [Groupings and analytics guide](../../../../docs/guides/bi/README.md) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `LEIM` | `lei-mapping` | external: GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI (CC0 1.0) — refreshed by `drishti.py feed run gleif` | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-mapping/` → `lake demo` → connector `gleif-store` |

### External sources

| Source | Where | Licence | Internal only | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers | https://api.gleif.org/api/v1 | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif -- api` |
| GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions | https://goldencopy.gleif.org | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif -- golden` |

Run these from the Drishti folder (the repository root, or the install folder of a release).

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status gleif                               # its last runs: last success, rows, failures (offline: the run ledger)
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif --dry-run                        # what would be fetched and loaded; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif                                  # pull today's data and load it into the lake `referencelake` (what the daily schedule runs)
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif --snapshot                       # refresh the committed pack instead: data/testdata/gleif, samples/ and this guide, then make.py --check
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif --snapshot --offline             # the same from the download cache only
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif -- --scope NAME:allianz,CAP:200  # a widened pull of more entities
```

The same with the Python you run Drishti with: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif` on Linux and macOS, `py tools\drishti.py feed run gleif` on Windows (every argument is passed on); the daily schedule entries: `drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`) ([WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md)).

### Into the lake, checking, offline

- **The lake.** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo` reads `data/testdata/testdata.yaml` and writes every dataset (test data, the committed public-data snapshots) into `<data>/delta/<domain>/<kind>/`, where the pack's Delta connector serves it; a computed kind needs nothing loaded. `lake build` loads your own large JSON exports the same way ([Command line](../../../../docs/guides/CLI_REFERENCE.md)).
- **Checking.** `python3 tools/contracts.py check` compares every contract with the pack and its data; each generator's `--check` (above) fails when the committed files differ from what it would write; in the console, `<MNEMONIC> <GO>` lists a kind and the pack's code opens its overview with the count of each kind.
- **Offline.** Everything committed works without a network: the test data and the public-data snapshots are in the repository and `lake demo` reads only them. A data feed runs offline from its download cache (`--offline`); a connector that reaches the internet (news, yfinance, the public-data feeds) is off as shipped and never starts on a machine configured offline (`drishti.offline.plugins`).
